title: Classical references to Gangaridai
detail: Greek and Latin writers used Gangaridai and related forms for a people or country, but their accounts differed about its location and relation to the Ganges.

title: Periplus describes the Ganges country
detail: Banglapedia's account of the Periplus notes a Ganges country on the Bay of Bengal and a market town named Gange; the identification with Gangaridai is an interpretation, not a settled location.

title: Ptolemy's delta description
detail: Ptolemy placed Gangaridai around the mouths of the Ganges and named Gange as a royal residence, but Banglapedia says the city cannot be located securely.

title: Regional states in Bengal
detail: Majumdar describes Bengal as divided among regional states, including Samatata in the eastern delta, before Gupta expansion.

title: Gupta incorporation, with Samatata excepted
detail: Banglapedia's Gupta Rule entry says most of Bengal had been incorporated into the Gupta Empire by the middle of the fourth century, except Samatata.
